# Model Overview (for Diagnosis)
The probe expects a unidirectional GRU4Rec with real-item embeddings, `log2feats`, `predict_score`, `_readout`, and `score_candidates`. Features have shape B × L × H. The sequence representation is gathered at the final nonpadding position of each left-padded history; empty histories receive zero states. Model implementation details beyond these interfaces are not supplied.

# Diagnosis Inputs & Hooks
`DiagnosisProbe(view, device)` accesses the actual network through `view.model`, embeddings through `view.item_emb`, and public training histories through `view.user_train`. The ModelView adapts NumPy sequences to features and scores candidate items. Up to ten loader batches provide `(None, sequence, positive, negative)` tensors of shape B × L. Diagnosis runs in evaluation/inference mode and restores module modes and Python/NumPy/Torch/CUDA RNG states afterward.

# Probes & Metrics
- **Embedding alignment:** Mean off-diagonal cosine among up to 2,048 item embeddings, mapped to [0,1]. Higher values indicate directional alignment, potentially collapse; this does not measure recommendation diversity.
- **Sampled separation:** Positive-minus-negative score mean, lower tenth percentile, negative-win rate, and fraction below 0.5 across valid training positions. Larger margins and lower failure rates indicate stronger sampled separation. Counts and positive-item frequency strata accompany results; unavailable item-category lists remain empty.
- **Execution consistency:** Checks shapes, finite outputs, exact same-tensor final-position readout, ModelView/module agreement, padding invariance, batching, repeated calls, empty histories, and prediction-entry parity. A temporary GRU hook verifies implicit zero initialization. Exported-predictor parity requires an explicit adapter.

# Perturbation & Tests
After correctness checks pass, select at most 200 eligible training users deterministically. Predict each final training interaction from its preceding prefix against 99 fixed unique unseen negatives. Compare intact histories with five full shuffles and five shuffles preserving the final item.

Measure state cosine distance/displacement, score RMS movement, margins, ties, and—only with the pinned ranking adapter—rank/HR@10 damage. Primary summaries retain unchanged draws. Report change accounting, slices, user-reweighting intervals, and separate permutation Monte Carlo errors.

# MODEL_DIAGNOSIS Schema & Limitations
`run_full_diagnosis` returns `metrics` and `metric_definitions`, including execution checks, temporal records, counts, and runtime; detailed temporal artifacts are saved locally. The interpreter requests status, findings, implications, and evidence.

These are conditional training-prefix measurements, not generalization or causal evidence. Missing measurements are null. Four-category macro estimates require external aggregation; official validation alone selects models.
